description.text:
Reads and evaluates an expression stored in a string.
The resulting value is returned. Notice that evalstring does not allow the outermost set of parentheses to be omitted from the evaluated expression, as in load or in the top level.

items.name: t_string
items.desc: String containing the SKILL expression to be evaluated.

items.name: s_langMode
items.desc: Must be a symbol. Valid values:

values.desc: Evaluates the given string in SKILL++ mode.
Evaluates the given string in SKILL mode. This is the default.

arguments.text:
t_string
String containing the SKILL expression to be evaluated.
s_langMode
Must be a symbol. Valid values:
'ils
Evaluates the given string in SKILL++ mode.
'il
Evaluates the given string in SKILL mode. This is the default.

items.desc: The value of the argument expression after evaluation.

returns.text:
g_value
The value of the argument expression after evaluation.
nil
No form is read.

example.text:
evalstring("1+2") => 3
The 1+2 infix notation is the same as (plus 1 2).
evalstring("cons('a '(b c))") => (a b c)
car '(1 2 3) => 1
evalstring("car '(1 2 3)")
Signals that car is an unbound variable.
